premises: Increasing Al in Al–Co–Cr–Fe–Ni HEAs drives a transition from disordered FCC to a microstructure with ordered precipitates (γ′-like phases).
This transition is driven by enhanced interatomic interactions that alter the enthalpy–entropy balance.
